race.description: Nsw Country Rugby Union Corellas Country Hcp (C2)
race.comment: SIRLEAF (3) proven at this level and returns from a 35-day let-up. Up sharply in class when he returned slick closing splits for a narrow second over 1400m at Tamworth in C3 grade. Will relish Thompson's 4kg claim on a better surface. Expected to go close. LYON (5) is in a rich vein of form and lines up for the hat-trick after registering a strong win over 1200m at Tamworth from the inside gate. Tempo suits and look for him launching late. QUICK SHARP (6) struggled to run out a solid 1400m with a tiring tenth at Dubbo from the good gate. Goes well on her home track and can overcome the sticky barrier. SMART BUY (7) progressive mare with her hoof on the till. Indicated a win was imminent when she savaged the line to secure third over 1400m at Tamworth. Leading player.
